name: Denver Solid Waste Management
notes: Kept on the catalog municipal-portal family (city self-service portal). Researched from the public denvergov.org Trash, Recycle & Compost page, the Denver Utilities Online page (also served as Make a Payment, Solid Waste Bills) and the Apply for Rebates link; the Denver Utilities Online portal itself (denvergov.my.site.com) was not signed into. Denver Utilities Online handles solid waste bills: pay bills, request cart size changes and repairs, sign up for paperless billing and AutoPay, submit billing questions and service requests. Account creation: Sign Up Now, e-mail verification code, then the Parcel ID and account number from the invoice, name and password (registrationFields cannot express parcelId; cross-owner request). Other ways to pay: check or money order to City and County of Denver, P.O. Box 735644, Dallas, TX 75373. Solid Waste cannot take payments by phone (documented: pay_by_phone unsupported). Billing questions via the portal or swmbillinginquiries@denvergov.org; Customer Care and Billing offices Monday-Thursday 7:30 a.m.-3:30 p.m., Friday 7:30 a.m.-1 p.m.; 3-1-1 / (720) 913-1311. Rebates (income-based) for solid waste services are applied for separately (payment_assistance). The fee depends on trash cart size, but no official price list was found on public pages, so no plans are set. Service is tied to the property, so cancel_service is unsupported online (inferred).

registration.note: Choose Sign Up Now, verify your e-mail with the code we send, then enter the Parcel ID and account number from your invoice.

pay_by_phone.note: Solid Waste cannot accept payments by phone. Pay in Denver Utilities Online, or mail a check or money order to City and County of Denver, P.O. Box 735644, Dallas, TX 75373.

guest_pay.note: Solid waste bills are paid after signing in to Denver Utilities Online, or by mailing a check or money order to City and County of Denver, P.O. Box 735644, Dallas, TX 75373.

payment_assistance.note: Eligible households can apply for a rebate on solid waste services.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Submit a billing question in Denver Utilities Online, e-mail swmbillinginquiries@denvergov.org or call 3-1-1 ((720) 913-1311).

cancel_service.note: Solid waste service stays with the property. For account transfers when you move, contact Solid Waste Customer Care and Billing through Denver Utilities Online or call 3-1-1 ((720) 913-1311).

help.title: Paying your solid waste bill
paragraphs: Denver Utilities Online is where you manage your solid waste account: pay bills, sign up for paperless billing and AutoPay, request cart size changes or repairs, and submit billing questions and service requests.
You can also send a check or money order to City and County of Denver, P.O. Box 735644, Dallas, TX 75373. Solid Waste cannot accept payments by phone.

help.title: Setting up your Denver Utilities Online account
paragraphs: On your first visit choose Sign Up Now and enter your e-mail address to receive a verification code. When creating the account, provide the Parcel ID and account number from your invoice for the service address, plus your e-mail address.

After verifying your e-mail, choose Continue, enter your name, pick a password and choose Create. Then sign in with your e-mail address and password. Recently moved? Look for an invoice in the mail for your new address.

help.title: Billing questions and customer service
paragraphs: Submit billing questions through your Denver Utilities Online account or by e-mail to swmbillinginquiries@denvergov.org. Solid Waste Customer Care and Billing offices are open Monday to Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. and Friday 7:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. For other help call 3-1-1, or (720) 913-1311 from outside Denver.

help.title: Rebates for solid waste services
paragraphs: Eligible households can apply for a rebate on solid waste services. Trash rebate participants who also get a stormwater bill receive the sidewalk rebate automatically, and current trash rebate recipients do not need to reapply until their rebate ends.

extra.intent: Using Denver Solid Waste Management's help pages, find which two numbers from your invoice you need to create a Denver Utilities Online account. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: You need the Parcel ID and the account number from your invoice.
